title.narrative: Indicator 5: Percentage of assistive devices still used by the beneficiaries 3 to 6 months after provision (SDG 3, 16)

description.narrative: Indicator 5: Percentage of assistive devices still used by the beneficiaries 3 to 6 months after provision (SDG 3, 16)

comment.narrative: Looking at the percentage of users of new and repaired Assistive Technology PO and devices who demonstrated skills and knowledge in use and maintenance of these devices after 3 to 6 months of provision the project found that 98 in both year 1 and 2 could demonstrate adequate knowledge on both how to use and maintain such devices. These achievements in both year 1 and 2 are well above the targeted 70 for the project period. Since the project started implementation in three target camps 644 devices have been followed up and 574 89 of the devices provided to users have remained in good working conditions and are appropriate for users. The measurement outcome is overachieved. This success can be attributed to the diligent monitoring and maintenance efforts put in place by the project team. Additionally regular feedback and support from the beneficiaries have contributed to the sustained use and effectiveness of the assistive devices.

description.narrative: Indicator 6: Percentage of people with functional limitations whose functional mobility has improved through development and implementation of Personalized Support Plan (PSP) in 3 targeted shelters (SDG 3, 8, 10, 16)

comment.narrative: Measuring the indicator related to beneficiaries showing active engagement in realizing Personalized Support Plans PSP the project reached 69.4 in the first year and 87 in second year. Due to the COVIDrelated restrictions during year 1 the project could not achieve the expected target set for year 1 of this action. However with the lifting of COVID19 restrictions in year 2 the expected target set for year 2 has been achieved. 841 people with disabilities reviewed the personal plan goals and 732 87 of them improved in functional mobility and achieved the target set in year two. This outcome demonstrates the effectiveness of the Personalized Support Plan PSP in improving functional mobility for people with disabilities. The high success rate of 87 indicates that the PSP has been instrumental in helping a significant number of people achieve their goals and enhance their overall quality of life within the target shelters. Overall the project target had been partly achieved.

title.narrative: Output 3 2. Indicator 9: Percentage of participants that completes all sessions provided for the agespecific HE batches.

description.narrative: The indicator measures the percentage of participants that have attended all of the sessions delivered for a specific agespecific group among the beneficiaries. Each group has a different set of topics and sessions. Once a participant has registered and completed all sessions will this be counted as complete.

comment.narrative: With regards to the percentage of participants completed all age specific cluster health 37 of participants have completed all sessions that developed for respective age group. Similarly the project could not conduct the ARH sessions with school children during the first year of implementation. The schools were closed throughout the first year and first half of the second year. Even though the project staffs were ready to implement the ARH sessions with the support of schoolteachers during the second half of the second year in both camps only MLO camp health committee gave the permissions to conduct sessions during schools hours. In MLO camp schools 46 of children have improved their knowledge by at least 30 slightly lower than the indicator target.
